subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should OpenClaw expose `send-location` and `normalizeMessageActionRequest` as supported cross-plugin channel contracts for this Telegram repair?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes the public Plugin SDK surface; choosing whether that API is generic, private, or replaced by an existing channel contract is an ownership decision that automated repair should not make.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Accept the new action and normalization hook as documented Plugin SDK surface, with owner-reviewed compatibility expectations and public-facade tests.

options.title: Keep it Telegram-local
options.body: Rework the repair to use an existing channel seam or a private bundled-plugin path so external channel plugins do not inherit a new contract.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Hold the PR until channel-contract owners choose the long-term normalization boundary and action naming model.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Accept the new action and normalization hook as documented Plugin SDK surface, with owner-reviewed compatibility expectations and public-facade tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is the closest identified steward of the public adapter and baseline surface.
